title: Migration Preview
summary: Reads a Postgres migration back step by step with what each step locks and what can't be undone, so it doesn't take production down or lose data.
description: Postgres migration reader (strings, dollar quotes, comments handled) showing what each step locks, which rewrite big tables and which drops can't be undone, and catching failing NOT NULL adds, mid-deploy renames, CONCURRENTLY in a transaction and no lock_timeout.
catches: Locks each step takes and what other sessions can't do meanwhile
Steps that rewrite or scan every row of a large table (from tableSizes)
Dropped tables and columns that can't be undone
NOT NULL without a default on existing rows, and renames that break running code
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY inside a transaction, and missing lock_timeout
limits: Postgres only, and lock behaviour can differ between versions
A static read: it doesn't run the SQL or know current load
Row counts only if you pass tableSizes
a11y: Section labelled by its title; summary uses role=status
Each step is labelled with its number; icons are aria-hidden
Fix and undo are buttons, and focus moves to Undo after a fix
server: Run migrations with lock_timeout and statement_timeout, test on a production-sized copy, and keep a rollback plan.
stops: Helps prevent a migration locking a production table for hours
